requirements.requirement: Review the repo, work line by line verifying from official sources, and provide links for manual review. Flag any irregularities for review.
requirements.clearing_number: 1 review, 1 flag register with links, 0 unsourced claims

requirements.requirement: Create a github page live site for this repo with a clean landing page and subpages organized by category.
requirements.clearing_number: 1 landing page plus category subpages, all generated and link-checked

requirements.requirement: It should contain all entries and findings in a simple, easy to read table format, and include any analysis and findings.
requirements.clearing_number: every finding appears in a table row with a source; 0 prose-only findings

requirements.requirement: Every table row must have a source link to an official site.
requirements.clearing_number: 0 table rows without a registered official link; enforced by the site check

requirements.requirement: If a value can't be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it as unverified. Never infer or fill in values.
requirements.clearing_number: 0 filled-in unverified values; every blank carries a reason

gates.name: Market numbers
gates.statement: No publisher of NFL prices is licensed for this use, and NFL.com publishes no odds. A market cell may not be filled from memory or from a non-registered page.
gates.clears_when: A registered, permitted source that prints a price with a timestamp.

gates.name: Who actually played
gates.statement: A depth chart rank is not participation. Without Game Books, inactive lists or snap counts, a replacement is suspected, never confirmed.
gates.clears_when: Official participation evidence joined to the expected starter.

gates.name: Playing time
gates.statement: Snap counts are the only official playing-time measure and none is captured.
gates.clears_when: An official snap-count table per game.

gates.name: Inactive lists
gates.statement: No game-day inactive list is captured, so 'did not play' cannot be separated from 'was not listed'.
gates.clears_when: One inactive list per game.

gates.name: Game Books
gates.statement: The NFL Game Book is the official record of starters and participation; none is captured.
gates.clears_when: One Game Book per captured game.

gates.name: Reserve lists
gates.statement: 24 of 32 club roster pages would need reading, and the reserve section parsed, before 'not listed' stops meaning 'unknown'.
gates.clears_when: 32 of 32 reserve lists captured.

gates.name: Designation reliability
gates.statement: A designation's meaning is a measured play rate, not a remembered percentage. The outcome side is missing.
gates.clears_when: Designations joined to inactive lists over several seasons.

gates.name: Time series
gates.statement: Three reads is a start, not a series. A delta needs at least two reads of the same artefact and a trend needs more.
gates.clears_when: Daily captures from Wednesday to kickoff.

gates.name: Automation
gates.statement: NFL.com section 1.3 prohibits systematic retrieval without written consent. No scheduled capture may be enabled.
gates.clears_when: Written consent, or an authorised structured source.

gates.name: Prospective record
gates.statement: Neither the corpus nor the leaderboard contains a single forecast recorded before kickoff.
gates.clears_when: Pre-kickoff timestamped forecasts.

gates.name: Season split
gates.statement: One season cannot be split into train, validation and holdout.
gates.clears_when: Three chronological seasons.

gates.name: Weather and roof
gates.statement: No forecast feed and no roof/surface register are captured.
gates.clears_when: A registered forecast source plus a stadium register.

gates.name: Rule regime
gates.statement: The 2026 rule text is not captured, so no regime prior is applied to totals or win probabilities.
gates.clears_when: The official rule document, quoted.

gates.name: Venue
gates.statement: The schedule page publishes a venue only through its ticket and hotel links, and the international games carry a label, not a stadium.
gates.clears_when: A league or club page printing the stadium for every fixture.

gates.name: Archive
gates.statement: Past-season reports are reachable but not archived here.
gates.clears_when: Weekly captures held for at least one full past season.

gates.name: Alerts
gates.statement: Row counts are pinned and the build fails on a missing field, but no alert fires outside CI.
gates.clears_when: A monitored freshness budget per source.

gates.name: Reward
gates.statement: A reward cannot be settled without an executable price and a rights decision.
gates.clears_when: One qualified entry.

gates.name: Player props
gates.statement: No player-level prop outcome is captured.
gates.clears_when: A prop outcome per player-game.

gates.name: Transactions
gates.statement: The transaction log is read as prose, not parsed as a versioned event stream.
gates.clears_when: A parsed, versioned transaction feed.

gates.name: Chart dates
gates.statement: Only one of seven club charts prints a date, so freshness cannot be established from the page.
gates.clears_when: A printed date per chart.

gates.name: Depth source
gates.statement: 26 of 32 clubs are verified on route (a). Route (b) needs an official snap-count feed.
gates.clears_when: 32 of 32 clubs on one route.

gates.name: Houston chart
gates.statement: The Houston depth chart is served as an image only.
gates.clears_when: An authorised structured source for the Houston chart.

gates.name: Prior claim
gates.statement: A prior desk's claim did not reproduce on a fresh read, so it is flagged rather than repeated.
gates.clears_when: A fresh read that reproduces the claim.

gates.name: Empty slot
gates.statement: The Washington page read today prints no empty slot, so the prior example is flagged rather than repeated.
gates.clears_when: A fresh read that prints an empty slot.

gates.name: Announced starters
gates.statement: One club's dated starter announcement is captured; the other clubs are not swept.
gates.clears_when: A dated announcement sweep.

gates.name: Availability feature
gates.statement: The ablation needs a verified availability feature; that feature is exactly what the gates above block.
gates.clears_when: A populated availability arm.
